method: Hand-labelled from CBP's published CAPE rules (IEEPA Duty Refunds page FAQ and error tables, ACE QRG Pub. 5552-0526, CSMS 69127837) by reading each entry's raw ES-003 row in data/sample-es003.csv, plus date arithmetic and refund netting done on the raw columns. The labelling did not call, read or copy src/lib/validate.ts or its output. Each label has a one-line reason. 'alsoDefensible' marks entries where CBP's text permits a second lane; strict scoring ignores it, lenient scoring accepts it.

laneDefinitions.FILE_NOW: CBP's checks would pass and the entry nets to a refund
laneDefinitions.WAIT: a CBP error or sequencing step must be cleared first (PSC, protest, status), after which the entry can go
laneDefinitions.BLOCKED: CBP rejects the entry and no fix makes it eligible this phase
laneDefinitions.NET_BILL_RISK: the entry nets to a bill (other duties owed exceed the IEEPA refund), so a broker decides
